about: Your shoe rotation. status: active | backup | retiring | retired | avoid. fit scores each shoe 0-3 for each kind of run and drives the suggestions. maxKm is when it should be retired. offsetKm adds distance run before you started tracking. Add and edit pairs in the app; this file is the starting point.
